rationale: CTIS reports actual trial start 20 March 2018, recruitment ending November 2020, and global trial end 2 October 2025. Treated cohort reported by April 2021. Registry start is not proven first dose; use conservative interval, exclude in stronger-entry sensitivity. Completion does not establish permanent failure or advancement.

Cystinosis autologous HSC gene therapy first treated October 2019. Original trial completed; long-term follow-up continues. Novartis DFT383 development provides a continuation lead, but exact manufacturing continuity should be checked before counting new trial as identical construct. Broad rare tier only: systemic cystinosis, not CNS-targeted.
Proposed Phase II and inconsistent vendor stages do not establish human dosing. No qualifying clinical exposure established in bounded search.
Friedreich ataxia programme described in sponsor filing; vendor abandoned Phase I not independently supported by a human-dosing record. Do not infer never dosed, but do not add an unverified entrant.
Sponsor 2021 pipeline describes preclinical Crigler-Najjar programme. No qualifying dosing evidence found; vendor Phase II is insufficient.

IND clearance is not dosing. Sponsor paused MLD programme in 2022 and transferred it in 2024; no treated patient established. Nearby first-dose statements concern PBFT02, not PBML04. Primary construct AAVhu68 differs from vendor AAV1 label.
UTSW CLN7 programme corresponds to existing aav9cln7 entry; no distinct dosed construct established. Company deprioritisation does not prove academic trial abandonment.
Genethon licensing/IP relationship to AVXS-101 does not establish another dosed molecule beyond existing onasemnogene entry.
Manufacturing/services umbrella spanning multiple clients and products, not a uniquely identifiable clinical molecule.
Foundation research umbrella, not a unique molecule. AXO-AAV-GM1 is already separately included; cannot count generic research label again.
Institutional research programme does not establish a distinct construct. Iowa being a study site is not sufficient to identify it as AMT-130 or another molecule.
2011 sponsor release describes Weill Cornell rAAVrh10 CLN2 dosing, represented by existing aavrh10cln2. No additional distinct construct established.
Generic licence/platform label cannot be mapped confidently to a distinct dosed construct. Existing aavrh10arsa may overlap, but alias not independently proven.

First-patient report observed by August 2025 and 2026 company partnership; exact dosing date not established. No evidence of entry within frozen 2010-2024 window. Retain recent watchlist, not a failure.
2026 registry and first-sentinel report put this outside 2010-2024 entry cohort. Primary report describes AAV9-NAGLU, not vendor enzyme-fusion modality. Retain watchlist.
